wikipedia.extract: The brant or brent goose (Branta bernicla) is a small goose in the genus Branta. There are three subspecies, all of which winter along temperate-zone sea-coasts and breed on the high-Arctic tundra.
wikipedia.title: Brant (goose)

commonNames.name: Blue Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The blue monkey or diademed monkey (Cercopithecus mitis) is a species of Old World monkey native to Central and East Africa, ranging from the upper Congo River basin east to the East African Rift and south to northern Angola and Zambia and populations further south down to South Africa. The taxonomy of this species has been disputed and Sykes' monkey, the silver monkey and the golden monkey are often regarded as subspecies.
wikipedia.title: Blue monkey

wikipedia.extract: Chauna is a genus of birds in the screamer family. Its two members are found in wetlands of South America.
wikipedia.title: Chauna

wikipedia.extract: Hadropithecus is a medium-sized, extinct genus of lemur, or strepsirrhine primate, from Madagascar that includes a single species, Hadropithecus stenognathus. Due to its rarity and lack of sufficient skeletal remains, it is one of the least understood of the extinct lemurs.
wikipedia.title: Hadropithecus

commonNames.name: Black-horned Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black capuchin (Sapajus nigritus), also known as the black-horned capuchin, is a capuchin monkey from the Atlantic Forest in south-eastern Brazil and far north-eastern Argentina. Historically, it was included as a subspecies of the tufted capuchin.
wikipedia.title: Black capuchin

wikipedia.extract: Attagis is a genus of seedsnipe, a South American family of small gregarious waders which have adapted to a vegetarian diet. These birds look superficially like partridges in structure and bill shape.
wikipedia.title: Attagis

commonNames.name: Indochinese Silvered Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Germain's langur (Trachypithecus germaini) is an Old World monkey native to Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos and Vietnam. The monkey was previously included in Trachypithecus cristatus and Trachypithecus villosus.
wikipedia.title: Germain's langur

wikipedia.extract: The mountain gorilla (Gorilla beringei beringei) is one of the two subspecies of the eastern gorilla. It is listed as endangered by the IUCN as of 2018.
wikipedia.title: Mountain gorilla

commonNames.name: Brown Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The brown titi monkey (Plecturocebus brunneus) is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, from South America. It is endemic to Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Brown titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: Conopophaga is a genus of birds in the gnateater family. Its members are found in forest and woodland in South America.
wikipedia.title: Conopophaga

commonNames.name: Mandrill
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Mandril
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The mandrill (Mandrillus sphinx) is a large Old World monkey native to west central Africa. It is one of the most colorful mammals in the world, with red and blue skin on its face and posterior.
wikipedia.title: Mandrill

commonNames.name: Common Marmoset
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: White-tufed-ear marmoset
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The common marmoset (Callithrix jacchus), also called white-tufted marmoset or white-tufted-ear marmoset, is a New World monkey. It originally lived on the northeastern coast of Brazil, in the states of Piauí, Paraíba, Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Pernambuco, Alagoas, and Bahia.
wikipedia.title: Common marmoset

wikipedia.extract: The Dryas monkey (Chlorocebus dryas), also known as Salonga monkey, ekele, or inoko, is a little-known species of Old World monkey found only in the Congo Basin, restricted to the left bank of the Congo River. It is now established that the animals that had been classified as Cercopithecus salongo (the common name being Zaire Diana monkey) were in fact Dryas monkeys.
wikipedia.title: Dryas monkey

wikipedia.extract: Homo erectus ( lit. 'upright man') is an extinct species of archaic human from the Pleistocene, spanning nearly 2 million years. It is the first human species to evolve a humanlike body plan and gait, to leave Africa and colonize Asia and Europe, and to wield fire.
wikipedia.title: Homo erectus

commonNames.name: Heuglin’s Patas Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Blue Nile patas monkey (Erythrocebus poliophaeus) or Heuglin's patas monkey is a species of Old World monkey found in Africa along the Blue Nile river valley in Ethiopia, Sudan, and potentially South Sudan. While first described in 1862, it was synonymized with the common patas monkey (E. patas) in 1927.
wikipedia.title: Blue Nile patas monkey
